segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combo skin report the cream feels lightweight, non-greasy, matte or balanced, and several say it works well through summer and even winter without feeling suffocating.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: many say it is surprisingly hydrating even for dry, flaky or dry-and-sensitive skin, while a couple find it not moisturizing enough in winter or in dry/cold climates.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including combo/oily and combo/sensitive, most often describe it as balanced, hydrating without greasiness, and layering well under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and rosacea-prone reviewers frequently report soothing, cooling, reduced redness and no irritation, but a minority describe a severe rosacea flare-up with redness, swelling, itching and burning.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as having normal skin (with a tendency to congestion) found it lightweight and non-greasy, with no breakout issues.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her late 30s and another 57-year-old repurchase repeatedly, describing it as hydrating and non-irritating for older skin, though this is not a heavily represented segment.

concerns.aging: The few reviewers who mention age (30s-50s) report the product as hydrating and gentle for their skin without complaints tied specifically to aging.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating, plumping and long-lasting even for dry or dehydrated skin; a few note it is too light to be sufficient in winter or very dry/cold climates.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including those with rosacea or general redness, report visible calming and reduction of redness; however, two reviewers describe a rosacea flare-up with new redness, swelling and burning after use.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the cream with repairing or supporting a damaged or compromised skin barrier, including post-surgery and after other product irritation, though one reviewer reports the product itself destroyed her barrier during a reaction.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with dry, flaky patches or dead-skin-like spots report these visibly improving or disappearing with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some clearing of hormonal or general acne, but a notable minority describe significant breakouts, whiteheads, cystic-like pimples or fungal-acne-type reactions.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers commonly report the product controls shine and leaves a matte or balanced finish without adding oiliness.

I ended up throwing it out, still half used, and went back to my Bubble/Anua combo, and my skin healed in about 5 days. Don't believe the hype.
